about: T-519 item 1 (DRAFT): SPIRITS. The lead is set by hand through DEBUG -> GAME EVENTS -> SPIRITS (a crossing plays on the next step): into good spirits (the screen rising: pulses to white, the lighter tone, the fanfare), the summary's fourth page with its words under the day's line, a potion in good spirits and its thanks; into low spirits (pulses to black, the darker tone, a hush), its words, a potion refused and kept; then back to as it is (no longer in low spirits). FOOD ALWAYS makes the food's chances certain, so the refusal and the thanks show every time. Not yet run: the theatre was down when it was written (2026-11-04). The theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's; nothing is saved.

stops.stop: Into good spirits: the crossing screen, rising
steps: burst "the crossing, rising: its cry, the pulses to white, the lighter tone" 14 24

stops.stop: The summary's words: in good spirits, under the day's line, and the picture lighter
steps: shot "the fourth page: In good spirits."

stops.stop: A potion in good spirits: it thanks you
Into low spirits: the crossing screen, falling
steps: burst "the crossing, falling: the pulses to black, the darker tone, a hush" 14 24
shot "the fourth page: In low spirits."

stops.stop: A potion in low spirits: refused, and the potion kept
Back to as it is: no longer in low spirits
steps: events "SPIRITS >" "LEAD: AS IT IS" "FOOD ALWAYS REFUSED/THANKED"
burst "the crossing back: the pulses to white, its own tone again" 14 24
